crossRefs.note: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.
A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in…
Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I…
For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according…
Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels…
For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just…
considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

translations.web: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
translations.bsb: By fruitful speech a man is filled with good things, and the work of his hands returns to him.
translations.kjv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered
translations.asv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth; And the doings of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
